problem_title: Minimum Distance Between Three Equal Elements I
approach_summary: Simplify the distance formula |i - j| + |j - k| + |k - i| for sorted indices i < j < k to 2 * (k - i). Track indices of each number using a hash map and check consecutive triplets of identical elements to find the minimum distance in O(N) time.

codes.Python:
"""
Problem: LeetCode 3740 - Minimum Distance Between Three Equal Elements I
Language: Python 3
Time Complexity: O(N)
Space Complexity: O(N)
"""
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def minimumDistance(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        indices = defaultdict(list)
        min_dist = float('inf')

        for i, val in enumerate(nums):
            indices[val].append(i)
            if len(indices[val]) >= 3:
                min_dist = min(min_dist, 2 * (indices[val][-1] - indices[val][-3]))

        return min_dist if min_dist != float('inf') else -1
